involved_tools.name: sequentialthinking
involved_tools.description:
Supports flexible, sequential problem-solving in which each step can extend, revise, or branch from earlier analysis. Use it to develop and check one coherent line of analysis when the problem benefits from incremental progress or course correction.

Usage rules:
- Use for a single evolving analysis path; use parallel-thinking when developing multiple approaches simultaneously.
- For every call, provide thought, nextThoughtNeeded, thoughtNumber, and totalThoughts. Both numeric fields must be integers of at least 1.
- Adjust totalThoughts as the analysis evolves; thoughtNumber may exceed the initial estimate when more steps are needed.
- When revising, set isRevision and identify the earlier step with revisesThought. When branching, use branchFromThought and, if useful, branchId.
- Use needsMoreThoughts to indicate that additional analysis is needed when nearing an apparent endpoint.
- Set nextThoughtNeeded to false only when the analysis is complete and a satisfactory result is ready.

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought step is needed

totalThoughts.description: Estimated total thoughts needed (numeric value, e.g., 5, 10)

involved_tools.name: run_process
involved_tools.description:
Run a process on the Darwin machine, either as a shell command or as an executable with separate arguments. The working directory is required. Optionally provide standard input, a timeout, or request a dry run.

Usage rules:
- Set the required mode to "shell" or "executable" and provide a non-empty cwd.
- For mode "shell", provide a non-empty command_line and do not provide argv.
- For mode "executable", provide a non-empty argv array whose first item is the executable, and do not provide command_line.
- Optionally set stdin to text that will be written to standard input; it is fully written and then closed.
- Optionally set timeout_ms to an integer from 1 to 300000 milliseconds; the default is 30000 milliseconds.
- Optionally set dry_run to explain what would run without executing it; it defaults to false.

argv.description: Executable and arguments. argv[0] is the executable. Required when mode='executable'. Forbidden when mode='shell'.

command_line.description: Shell command line. Required when mode='shell'. Forbidden when mode='executable'.

cwd.description: Working directory. Required and must be a non-empty string.

dry_run.description: Optional explain what would run, defaults to False.

mode.description: What are you running, two choices: 'shell' or 'executable' (required, no default)

stdin.description: Optional text written to STDIN (written fully, then closed). Useful for heredoc-style input or file contents.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds, must be an integer between 1 and 300000, defaults to 30,000ms
